statement.name: GetMail
statement.sql:
select MMC.MessageId AS MessageId, ResourceTypeCode, ResourceInstance, SenderId, ReceiptToList, ReceiptCCList, ReceiptBCCList, Subject, Body, MessageDate, (select AttachmentId from mail_attachment AS Mail_Attachment where messageid = MMC.MessageId for xml auto) as AttachmentId FROM mail_message_context MMC join mail_message MM on MM.MessageId = MMC.MessageId join Mail_Body MB on MB.MessageId = MM.MessageId join mail_messagelog MML on MML.MessageId = MM.MessageId
ORDER BY MM.MessageDate desc

statement.name: GetMails
statement.sql:
DECLARE @ResourcesXml as XML,@StandardMessageContextCodeXml as XML SELECT @ResourcesXml = '' SELECT @StandardMessageContextCodeXml = ''
MMC.MessageId AS MessageId, MMC.ResourceTypeCode, ResourceInstance, SenderId, ReceiptToList, ReceiptCCList, ReceiptBCCList, Subject, Body, MessageDate, IsNull(MM.Attachments, 0) as AttachmentsCount, LSMC.LongDisplayValue as StandardMessageContextCodeText, MMC.ResourceValue, MMC.StandardMessageContextCode, (select AttachmentId from mail_attachment AS Mail_Attachment where messageid = MMC.MessageId for xml auto) as AttachmentId
FROM ( SELECT Items.r.value('@ResourceValue[1]','varchar(75)') AS ResourceValue FROM @ResourcesXml.nodes('Resource') as Items(r) ) HR join mail_message_context MMC on HR.ResourceValue = MMC.ResourceValue
JOIN ( SELECT Items.r.value('@StandardMessageContextCodeValue[1]','int') AS StandardMessageContextCode FROM @StandardMessageContextCodeXml.nodes('StandardMessageContextCode') as Items(r) ) SC on MMC.StandardMessageContextCode = SC.StandardMessageContextCode
join mail_message MM on MM.MessageId = MMC.MessageId join Mail_Body MB on MB.MessageId = MM.MessageId join mail_messagelog MML on MML.MessageId = MM.MessageId Left Join LookupStandardMessageContext LSMC On MMC.StandardMessageContextCode = LSMC.LookupCode

MMC.StandardMessageContextCode

statement.name: GetMailByMessageId
statement.sql:
SELECT MM.MessageId AS MessageId, SenderId, ReceiptToList, ReceiptCCList, ReceiptBCCList, [Subject], Body, MessageDate, (SELECT AttachmentId FROM mail_attachment AS Mail_Attachment WHERE messageid = MM.MessageId FOR XML AUTO) AS AttachmentId FROM mail_message MM JOIN Mail_Body MB ON MB.MessageId = MM.MessageId JOIN mail_messagelog MML ON MML.MessageId = MM.MessageId
ORDER BY MM.MessageDate desc
